items.title: Zcash Co-Founder Proposes Ending ZCG's 8% Block Reward Share
items.summary: Sean Bowe's draft ZIP would redirect Zcash Community Grants' 8% of new ZEC to the Network Sustainability Mechanism, arguing its roughly $125M in reserves is enough.
